olineSource.name: PFF — 2026 NFL offensive line rankings
olineSource.summary: PFF grades all 32 lines off individual player grades weighted toward pass protection, using three years of performance history. Rankings move weekly with injuries and lineup changes; in-season results start feeding in after Week 4.

themes.title: Injuries reshaped the board
themes.body: Tunsil, Cade Mays, Ekwonu, Moton and Dalman's retirement are the single biggest movers in the rankings.

themes.title: Heavy rookie dependence
themes.body: Conerly, Fano, Ersery, Proctor and Freeling are all being asked to start and adjust immediately.

themes.title: Coaching churn
themes.body: Jeff Stoutland leaving Philadelphia and Dwayne Ledford leaving Atlanta for Baltimore are flagged as real disruptors.

secondOpinion.name: Action Network — 2026 NFL offensive line rankings
secondOpinion.author: Brandon Anderson
secondOpinion.summary: Ranks all 32 lines into named tiers on four criteria: the unit over its best individual, continuity, depth and versatility, and scheme fit. Qualitative only — the O-Line input on this page stays PFF's rank.

pythagSource.name: 2025 Pythagorean wins
pythagSource.summary: Pythagorean expectation converts points scored and allowed into the record a team 'should' have had. Wins Above Pythag is actual wins minus that expectation: positive means they won more than their scoring justified (a regression candidate), negative means they were better than their record (a bounce-back candidate).

winTotalSource: Consensus regular-season win total: the line whose de-vigged Over price sits closest to even across DraftKings, FanDuel and theScore, priced at the average of those books' implied probabilities at that line.
